ui_bugs.issue: After successful QuickAddSupplier onCreated from Trip form (Priority E), form.supplier_id gets set (mandatory-warning disappears) but the SearchableSelect visually still displays placeholder 'Select supplier…' — the new supplier's label does not render. Same visual gap seen when the linked supplier on a chosen supplier-vehicle is present in the company. Root cause is almost certainly that SearchableSelect's `selected = options.find(o => o.value === value)` returns null because the `suppliers` list prop hasn't refetched in time (or the component doesn't re-render on options change). Suggest: after onCreated, push the new supplier into a local optimistic options array OR use `select` after `await refetch()` (not just invalidateQueries). File: /app/frontend/src/pages/TripForm.jsx:448-453 & /app/frontend/src/components/QuickAddModals.jsx:232-241.

action_items: Priority E — fix visual auto-select of newly-created supplier in trip-supplier-picker after QuickAddSupplier. Consider pushing an optimistic option {value:s.id,label:s.name} into the SupplierSection so the SearchableSelect immediately reflects the selection, independent of the ['suppliers'] query refetch timing.
critical_code_review_comments: SearchableSelect display logic (line 35 & 75-76) depends solely on options.find matching value — any race between parent state update and options refetch produces a false-empty picker. Consider a fallback `label: selectedLabelOverride || options.find(...).label || value` prop for callers that just created the option.

In QuickAddModals.jsx QuickAddSupplier onSuccess (line 234-239): the sequence is `qc.invalidateQueries → onCreated → onClose`. invalidateQueries is fire-and-forget; onCreated fires before the refetch completes. This is the origin of the Priority-E UX gap.
TripDetailsSection.jsx line 58 correctly hides inactive vehicles while preserving the currently-selected one on edit — clean and safe.

Trip form save-trip-btn is disabled state not tested when supplier missing on supplier vehicle — the SupplierSection's mandatory hint is only a visual warning, backend enforces via TripForm.jsx:266 pre-submit check. Consider disabling save-trip-btn as well for consistent UX.

rca of the issue: Priority-E visual auto-select gap RCA: TripForm.jsx passes suppliers list to SupplierSection which passes it to SearchableSelect. When QuickAddSupplier saves, it calls qc.invalidateQueries(['suppliers']) then onCreated(setForm supplier_id/name) then onClose. invalidateQueries is asynchronous — the refetch may not complete before React re-renders SearchableSelect with the new value. SearchableSelect computes `selected = options.find(o => o.value === value)` — if options[] doesn't yet include the just-created supplier, selected is null → placeholder is rendered. Mitigation: (1) await refetch() in QuickAddSupplier.onSuccess before firing onCreated, OR (2) let SupplierSection maintain an optimistic 'shadowSupplier' state that is merged into the options list when the newly-created supplier isn't yet in the query cache.
